purpose: PvE failure-path regression, the counterpart to U-pve-fullmatch.json's win path: lobby -> create a PvE room -> F5 start -> send GameCampaign 2 (exec, 'mission failed') exactly once instead of the GameCampaign 1 win loop -> wait for the automatic return to the room -> leave the room -> back in the lobby. dispatch/lobby.dispatch.js's Campaign_CN handler (0x00230139) only runs the R-ROUND round-advance branch for action===1 -- action===2 always falls straight through to a single EndGame_SN broadcast with no round advance and, unlike the win path, no packetlog.marker() call, so campaign_fail()'s completion signal is the raw {ev:'pkt', dir:'send', op:'0x00222213'} record in the session log instead of a marker line (see campaign_fail() in actions.py). 🟡 not run live yet.
